profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer bringing 6+ years of experience building interactive mobile applications, real-time systems, and unique gaming experiences. My work spans cross-platform development with React Native and TypeScript, hardware integration, and performance-focused application architecture.

My expertise spans the full product lifecycle, from conceptualization to production, developing experiences that combine software, hardware, and data to deliver meaningful insights to users. This includes building mobile applications that integrate with launch monitor hardware, stream and process real-time telemetry, and visualize ball flight and performance metrics to help golfers improve their game.

I’m especially interested in creating interactive, high-performance experiences that translate complex data into intuitive user interfaces. Whether developing simulation-based training tools or engaging gameplay systems, I enjoy solving technical challenges and collaborating closely with designers, product teams, and engineers to bring ambitious ideas to life.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Developing “Launch”, a cross-platform golf training application built with React Native and TypeScript, integrating with launch monitor hardware to deliver real-time golf performance insights.
- Led development of core product features including BLE integrations, device and app settings, My Bag management, and training modes such as Practice, Speed, and Target sessions.
- Architected and implemented Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) connectivity between the mobile application and launch monitor devices, including designing the custom Bluetooth communication protocol, packet structure, and binary packet parsing pipeline for reliable device interaction.
- Built and maintained firmware communication layers, enabling command/control messaging, device configuration, and bidirectional telemetry between the mobile application and hardware.
- Implemented OTA firmware update infrastructure over BLE, including chunked firmware transfer and device state management.
- Own end-to-end management of hardware data streams, transforming high-frequency device telemetry into real-time insights within the mobile experience.
- Built and maintained reusable React Native components and TypeScript modules within a shared internal Blue Tees package, accelerating feature development across multiple internal applications.
- Designed and integrated backend APIs that unify user, device, and performance data across the broader Blue Tees ecosystem.
- Collaborate closely with product and design teams to translate product requirements into scalable, user-centered mobile features.

positions.title: Senior Game Engineer
positions.description:
- Played a key role in the development and release of Lumos' first Unity game, What's My Name? on the flagship product.
- Rebuilt and revamped Penguin Rally, a spatial orientation racing game, by adding more practice opportunities and optimizing level progression, resulting in improved player experience and engagement.
- Designed and developed an inductive reasoning problem-solving game, Ruled Out, from concept to completion.
- Contributed to the development and ongoing maintenance of systems shared between games.

positions.title: Game Engineer
positions.insights: Version Control, Code Review and +2 skills

positions.title: Game Developer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Collaborated with a team of developers, artists, and golfers to build FSX Pro, an industry-leading golf fitting and coaching application, from the ground up.
- Participated in design and system architecture discussions, including the design and implementation of a tagging system that enables users to create and apply custom tags to individual golf shots during training sessions.
- Optimized app performance to ensure consistent usage on both PC and tablet platforms.
- Maintained and improved existing games in the Foresight catalog, such as Golf Roulette, Foresight Fairgrounds, and Skill Drill.

positions.title: IT Technician
positions.description:
- Provided technical support and troubleshooting for system hardware and software at University of Oregon's Lundquist College of Business.
- Updated and maintained technical documentation to ensure effective communication with clients.
positions.insights: Technical Proficiency, Technical Documentation and +4 skills
